faq.question: What coffee beans do you use?
faq.answer: We source 100% specialty Arabica beans directly from sustainable shade-grown estates in Chikmagalur and Coorg, India, roasted in-house weekly.

faq.question: Do you have vegan and dairy-free options?
faq.answer: Yes! All our coffees and teas can be prepared with Barista Oat Milk or Almond Milk. We also offer certified vegan pastries, sandwiches, and cold brews.

faq.question: Are your food items fresh?
faq.answer: Our croissants, muffins, bagels, and sandwiches are baked and prepared fresh every morning by our in-house pastry chef.

faq.question: Do you have drinks without caffeine?
faq.answer: Yes! We offer Belgian Hot Chocolate, Iced Belgian Chocolate, Herbal Chamomile Tea, and decaf coffee options.

faq.question: What is the price range of beverages?
faq.answer: Our beverages range from ₹160 for a Classic Espresso up to ₹330 for specialty blended frappes. Most regular coffee drinks are under ₹300.
